title: Code Review is now generally available
summary: Claude Code's automated PR review is now generally available for Team and Enterprise plans. Reviews finish in about 6-10 minutes, down from about 20 in preview, and findings are shorter and clearer, each stating the problem, trigger, and fix. Admins can set per-repo review depth (Quick, Standard by default, or Deep), and setup means enabling it in Claude Code settings, installing the GitHub App, and selecting repos.

title: Introducing Claude Duet
summary: Claude Duet is a research preview of a standalone proactive-agent app on iOS, Android, and claude.ai. It sends a morning brief across connected apps, checks them every few hours, and works in its own VM when devices are off, showing planned messages, payments, signatures, and deletions for approval before acting. A new classifier blocks sharing of the most sensitive data such as card numbers and government IDs, and access is by waitlist, starting with US Pro and Max users who share usage limits with Claude.

title: Claude Security now scans continuously and tracks fixes
summary: The latest Claude Security version is in public beta for Claude Enterprise, connecting to Git repos including GitHub Enterprise Server with a baseline scan followed by risk-based rescans of changed code. Findings are automatically marked fixed when a fix ships and reopen if they recur, while a per-project knowledge base and editable threat model drive severity ratings. It also offers an API, webhooks, an MCP connector, and role-based access controls.

title: Building effective agent automations
summary: A reference implementation shows a scheduled daily-brief agent on Claude Managed Agents (beta) that reads Slack and GitHub PRs and posts a brief to Slack, configured through files applied with the ant CLI and credentials kept in a vault. It uses per-source bookmarks instead of fixed windows, reports unreadable sources, and counts a send only on Slack's "ok": true, with guardrails including a read-only GitHub token, a memory store, a host allowlist, and a per-run budget cap. The code is at anthropics/claude-quickstarts under managed-agents/daily-brief.

title: HCLTech joins the Claude Partner Network as a Global Premier partner
summary: HCLTech, with 230k+ employees across 60 countries, becomes a Global Premier Partner in the Claude Partner Network. It will build agentic solutions on Claude through a dedicated business unit and Center of Excellence, embed Claude in select HCLSoftware products, and add Claude and Claude Code to its AI Force platform. Safeguards include sandbox testing, policy guardrails, and human approval for production changes, bringing Claude into regulated sectors such as banking, healthcare, telecom, and manufacturing.

title: How an Anthropic BDR in Japan runs his day with Claude Managed Agents
summary: Japan business development representative Shahboz Ibragimov runs six agents called "Nakama" on Claude Managed Agents (beta) to route and qualify leads, update Salesforce, draft emails, and summarize meetings. Managed Agents provides single definitions, schedules, shared memory, and vaulted credentials, with cheaper models for rule-based tasks, Opus for judgment, and Claude Tag handling Slack follow-ups. He estimates about 60 hours per week saved.
